name: Effect: Path of the Tempest

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

text:
Granted by Path of the Tempest

Your familiar summons winds that speed up and protect you. You gain a +10-foot status bonus to your Speed until the end of your turn. When you Stride this turn, you don't trigger reactions. In addition, you don't need to Stride before a Long Jump this turn.
